name: LLM Fundamentals
description: How transformer LLMs work: tokenization, attention, decoding strategies, context windows, model selection, latency/cost trade-offs.

name: Prompt Engineering
description: Prompt patterns, few-shot vs zero-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling, prompt injection mitigation.

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: Chunking, retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, query rewriting, evaluation, and production hardening of RAG systems.

name: AI Agents
description: Tool-using agents: planning, ReAct, reflection, multi-agent patterns, memory, error handling, human-in-the-loop, evaluation.

name: Agent Frameworks
description: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants, MCP — when to use each, trade-offs, and pitfalls.

name: Vector Search & Embeddings
description: Embedding models, similarity, ANN indexes (HNSW/IVF), hybrid search, reranking, dimension trade-offs.

name: LLM Evaluation
description: Offline vs online eval, golden sets, LLM-as-judge, RAG metrics (faithfulness, relevance), agent trajectory evaluation, A/B testing.

name: MLOps & LLMOps
description: Deployment, observability, tracing, evaluation pipelines, prompt versioning, cost monitoring, drift, model lifecycle.

name: Safety & Responsible AI
description: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII handling, content filters, bias, hallucination mitigation, red-teaming, governance.

name: ML / DL Foundations
description: Core ML/DL concepts every AI engineer should hold: gradient descent, regularization, overfitting, transformers, fine-tuning vs RAG.

name: Python for AI
description: Python language essentials and AI-stack libraries: asyncio, typing, FastAPI, pydantic, pytest — focused on AI engineering.

name: Azure AI Stack
description: Azure OpenAI, AI Search, AI Foundry, Document Intelligence, Content Safety, and how they compose into AI applications.

name: AI System Design
description: End-to-end designs for AI features: scaling, observability, cost, multi-tenancy, resilience, data flow, deployment.

name: .NET / C#
description: C# language fundamentals, async/await, LINQ, EF Core, ASP.NET Core, dependency injection, and the broader .NET ecosystem.

name: Java & Spring
description: Core Java, concurrency, JVM, Spring Boot / Spring Framework, and idiomatic backend patterns.

name: Azure Platform
description: Azure compute and integration services: API Management, Functions, Logic Apps, AKS, Key Vault, IoT, App Service.

name: Frontend (SPA)
description: Modern single-page apps with Angular and React: state, rendering, performance, accessibility, and integration patterns.

name: Cloud & Platform Migration
description: Strategies for moving workloads to Azure: AWS→Azure, on-prem→cloud, Strangler Fig, IoT Edge / Greengrass migrations.

name: Behavioral & STAR
description: STAR-format stories interviewers actually ask: ownership, ambiguity, failure, cross-functional partnership, disagreement, working backwards from customer.

name: Engineering Leadership
description: People management loop: hiring, performance, growth, conflict, prioritization, org design, IC→manager transition, partnership with PM/design/data.

name: Staff+ IC Track
description: Staff/Principal/Distinguished IC signal: technical strategy, scope, influence-without-authority, architecture review, multiplier effect, RFC/ADR culture.
